assigned.description: A lane a person with lane authority raised the object to. Never lower than an earlier one.

inputs.description: The input marking versions the effective lane was computed from (provenance edges).

override.description: An approved declassification of this object: it then contributes this lane, whatever its inputs.

effective_lane.description:
The most sensitive of the assigned (or creation) lane and every input's effective lane, or the
override's lane. Absent on versions recorded before task 1.9, where it equals `lane`.

change_request_id.description: The approved change request that caused this version, when one did.

description:
One version of an object's marking (workbench specification 11.3 M-1, M-2). `lane` is the lane the
object carried when it was created and is the same in every version. Each later version records
why the effective lane was computed again; no version is ever edited.
